title: Short-Term Rental Lease Renewal Request Form
subtitle: Operational lease renewal request intake, evidence, qualified review, exception routing, handoff, and accountable closeout.
description: An original fillable short-term rental lease renewal request workflow that keeps identity, property-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exceptions, communication, and closeout in one traceable record.
use_case: Use when authorized property staff need to manage a short-term rental lease renewal request from intake through verified handoff without using the record to make legal, accommodation, screening, compliance, or professional conclusions.

sections.title: Renewal request identity and routing
sections.guidance: Record a request, not an agreement.

blocks.label: Lease Renewal Request reference
blocks.guidance: Use one identifier across messages, evidence, work orders, and handoffs.

blocks.label: Property and location
blocks.guidance: Confirm the exact property record before collecting workflow details.

blocks.label: Reporting and routing contact
blocks.guidance: Record only contact information needed to route and update this record.

blocks.label: Current term and response timing
blocks.guidance: Use approved records to verify dates before review.

sections.title: Requested outcome and change routing
sections.guidance: Capture what the requester is asking for.

blocks.label: Renewal preference
blocks.guidance: A stated preference is not acceptance or an approved offer.

blocks.label: Related requests requiring separate routing
blocks.guidance: Record the route and reference, not sensitive supporting details.
items: Occupant, roommate, business, or authorized-contact update
Parking, storage, access, amenity, or service change
Animal, assistance-animal, service-animal, or pet request
Communication, access, or accommodation request
Transfer, relocation, room, unit, suite, or space change
Repair, condition, or unresolved maintenance concern
Payment, billing, deposit, fee, or financial question
Complaint, dispute, legal, or policy-interpretation question

blocks.label: Requested change and separate workflow
blocks.guidance: Do not imply approval by listing a requested change.

blocks.label: Questions, priorities, requested discussion, and preferred outcome
blocks.guidance: Avoid diagnosis, protected-trait information, or unrelated personal history.

fields.label: Requester's words, requested outcome, communication need, and supporting reference

blocks.label: Accommodation and protected-request routing
blocks.guidance: If the request includes an accommodation or communication adjustment, record only the operational request and route it through the established qualified process. Do not request diagnosis or protected-trait details on this renewal record.

sections.title: Short-Term Rental context and responsibility
sections.guidance: Apply controls that are specific to this property type.

blocks.label: Short-Term Rental workflow controls
blocks.guidance: Check only controls actually reviewed; explain exceptions in the routing note.
items: Request identifies the booking, stay extension, or longer-term transition
A stay extension is not treated as an executed lease by this form
Availability, cleaning, rate, platform, and access reviews are separated
Occupancy, legal, tax, or licensing questions route to qualified staff
Guest complaints or protected activity are excluded from criteria
Host approval and platform confirmation have separate references
Conflicting future reservations have an escalation owner
Final terms are delivered only through an authorized booking channel

blocks.label: Responsibility and external handoff
blocks.guidance: A routing field records ownership; it does not decide disputed responsibility.

blocks.label: Short-Term Rental coordination facts and unresolved questions
blocks.guidance: Separate observed facts from assumptions and identify the next authorized reviewer. For short-term rental renewal, identify whether the request is a booking extension, new reservation, or transition to another occupancy process. Keep platform availability, future bookings, cleaning, access rotation, host approval, rate communication, licensing, tax, and relocation routes separate.

fields.label: Property-specific facts, limitations, handoff details, and unresolved question

blocks.label: Qualified review controls
blocks.guidance: This checklist supports process discipline and does not establish legal compliance.
items: Correct agreement, dates, parties, and authorized contacts verified
Current documented criteria and approval authority identified
Comparable requests use the same review sequence
Maintenance requests, complaints, accommodation activity, and protected activity excluded
Protected traits, assumptions, and unrelated personal information excluded
Missing, conflicting, or disputed records are identified
Legal, fair-housing, privacy, tax, or policy questions are escalated
No final term is communicated before authorized review

blocks.label: Review item and evidence register
blocks.guidance: Record objective sources and unresolved gaps; do not score protected or irrelevant information.

blocks.label: Review status and authority
blocks.guidance: Status is internal routing and is not a decision notice.

blocks.label: Objective review summary, missing information, and unresolved question
blocks.guidance: Do not include legal conclusions or protected-trait reasoning.

fields.label: Relevant facts, evidence sources, missing items, conflict, qualified reviewer, and next step

blocks.label: Operational and qualified-review boundary
blocks.guidance: This lease renewal request record captures operational facts, routing, evidence, and authorized handoffs. It does not determine legal rights, tenancy, responsibility, habitability, code or accessibility compliance, accommodation eligibility, screening eligibility, or a professional opinion. Authorized property staff must review applicable policy, notice, privacy, retention, fair-housing, safety, insurance, and licensed-trade requirements.

sections.title: Authorized option, delivery, and response
sections.guidance: Keep approval, delivery, and acceptance distinct.

blocks.label: Renewal option under consideration
blocks.guidance: Use approved document references rather than recreating binding terms here.

blocks.label: Authorized communication
blocks.guidance: This row does not itself create an offer or agreement.

blocks.label: Delivery, question, revision, and response log
blocks.guidance: Keep revision history and delivery evidence traceable.

blocks.label: Delivery failure, disputed term, requested revision, or exception
blocks.guidance: Do not change approved terms without documented authority.

fields.label: Issue, immediate action, authorized reviewer, due point, communication plan, and disposition

sections.title: Execution handoff and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Close only after documents and systems agree.

blocks.label: Execution and handoff verification
blocks.guidance: Do not treat a signature on this workflow record as execution of renewal documents.
items: Final approved document identity and revision are verified
All required authorized parties completed the approved process
Requester received a copy through the approved channel
Dates, billing, access, service, and occupancy systems are updated
Separate accommodation, animal, transfer, or complaint routes remain linked
Withdrawn, declined, expired, or unresolved status is communicated
Open conditions retain owners, due points, and escalation routes
Record retention and access controls are applied

blocks.label: Final workflow outcome
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized-system result without adding a legal characterization.

blocks.label: Remaining action and handoff register
blocks.guidance: A pending required action prevents final closure.

blocks.label: Workflow preparation and qualified closeout review
blocks.guidance: Signatures confirm review of this operational record, not execution, waiver, or agreement to lease terms.
